# Random and mutant genomes for cHardwareTransSMT (hw_type 2), traced by the
# C++ reference (cbuild/work/avida -a -set KEY VALUE..., analyze
# LOAD_SEQUENCE... + TRACE trace_out/ 0 <update> <random>) with the
# tests/fixtures/transsmt config and the settings given per batch.
# BATCH <name> <fixed|random inputs> <update> [KEY=VALUE settings...]
# SEQ <sequence> <fnv1a64 of the trace> <trace length in bytes>
# Each batch has 27 genomes (generator seed 12): 20 random genomes over the
# whole instruction set, 3 mutants of parasite-smt.org and 4 mutants of
# evolved-not.org (both from avida-core/tests/set_random_seed/config).
# Left out of the instruction set: Apoptosis (the reference segfaults
# printing the dead organism's trace footer) and NULL (the reference rejects
# it in an instruction set).
# The reference also segfaults now and then (depending on ASLR) after the
# last trace is written; the hashes come from runs that exited with status 0.
BATCH base fixed -1
